gns: the moment functional on polynomials yields a Hilbert completion with multiplication Y_h satisfying 0<=Y_h<=1 and b_n=<v_t,Y_h^n v_t>
cross_step_coherence: Y_(h1+h2)=Y_h1 Y_h2, Y_0=1, and strong continuity
generator: cross-step coherence yields Y_h=exp(-hL) for a positive self-adjoint generator L
arithmetic_advantage: all matrix entries are undifferentiated values of the completed explicit H, so cutoff tails avoid derivative powers of log(n)
caution: separate GNS constructions for each h do not supply cross-step coherence or one common Hilbert space
acceptance_test: Construct the two Hankel/localizing cone factors directly from H_explicit for rational t,h, then prove their GNS realizations descend to one strongly continuous positive-contraction semigroup with the required cross-step identities.
